overview:
TX-18 covers much of Houston and leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan lean of roughly 29 points toward Democrats. Christian Menefee, the Democratic incumbent, is running for re-election. He has raised about $3.6 million and draws roughly $7 million in outside support, with no recorded outside spending against him. Republican Ronald Whitfield shows no reported fundraising or cash on hand.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this general election, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and campaign finance. Prediction markets price the Democratic chance near 97 percent. Given the district's strong Democratic tilt and Menefee's financial dominance, the seat is rated Safe D with an expected margin near 29 points. Turnout patterns or late spending could shift the number, but the underlying partisan balance makes a Republican win improbable.
